title: Inquest into the death of Corey John Cross
article: An inquest for a man found dead in his prison cell will begin at the end of July.
A public inquest into the death of Corey John Cross has been scheduled for July 30 to August 3 in Swift Current.
36 year-old Cross was found dead in his prison cell at the Swift Current RCMP detachment in April '09.
The office of the Chief Coroner is responsible for the investigation.
